Intake note (Commercial team, 3 June 2022). Our client Fatima Saxena is a 54-year-old restaurant owner who lives at Flat 4C, Aliganj, Lucknow 226020 and can be reached on +91 79563 08204 or fatima.saxena@example.in. The client's PAN WDPPS7030K.
The client consulted us about a cheque bounce matter against Mehra Textiles Pvt Ltd. A cheque for 15.8 lakh rupees issued by M/s Mehra Textiles Pvt Ltd bounced: the cheque came back with the remark account closed.
The matter was filed as S.C.C. No. 364/2022 before the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Lucknow on 28 July 2022.
